newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse index ends higher in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse index ends higher in moderate trade.

text.p: Ghana's stock exchange index closed slightly higher in moderate trade on Monday, the market report said.
The all-share index closed at 379.00 from 377.58 on Friday.
The volume of shares traded fell to 47,200 from 423,470 on Friday.
Mobil Oil Ghana rose the most (+100 cedis to 6,300 cedis). The main loser was Pioneer Aluminium PAF.GH (-15 cedis to 145 cedis).
Shares on offer decreased to 301,920 against 676,890 on Friday. Bids also fell, down to 4,750,740 from 5,190,640.
